diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c
index 451ec9620226..c87054256dd9 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c
@@ -2247,6 +2247,14 @@ int drm_crtc_vblank_start_timer(struct drm_crtc *crtc)
 
 	drm_calc_timestamping_constants(crtc, &crtc->mode);
 
+	/*
+	 * If the frame duration is longer than 100ms, drm_wait_one_vblank()
+	 * will timeout and warn. Since this helper is for simulated vblanks,
+	 * we reject such slow refresh rates.
+	 */
+	if (!vblank->framedur_ns || vblank->framedur_ns > 100000000)
+		return -EINVAL;
+
 	spin_lock_irqsave(&vtimer->interval_lock, flags);
 	vtimer->interval = ns_to_ktime(vblank->framedur_ns);
 	spin_unlock_irqrestore(&vtimer->interval_lock, flags);

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c
index 451ec9620226..0568ca03c7de 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/drm_vblank.c
@@ -2247,6 +2247,15 @@ int drm_crtc_vblank_start_timer(struct drm_crtc *crtc)
 
 	drm_calc_timestamping_constants(crtc, &crtc->mode);
 
+	/*
+	 * If the frame duration is longer than 50ms, drm_wait_one_vblank()
+	 * might timeout and warn. If it is too short (less than 1ms), it
+	 * might flood the system. Since this helper is for simulated vblanks,
+	 * we reject such extreme refresh rates.
+	 */
+	if (vblank->framedur_ns < 1000000 || vblank->framedur_ns > 50000000)
+		return -EINVAL;
+
 	spin_lock_irqsave(&vtimer->interval_lock, flags);
 	vtimer->interval = ns_to_ktime(vblank->framedur_ns);
 	spin_unlock_irqrestore(&vtimer->interval_lock, flags);
